scope: Explicit owner-supplied interpretations of combined parts references. resolutions.scope_note: The owner identifies three individual A-series watches within this combined reference. All three exact identifiers were already present independently in the master database. Keep the original combined parts reference and provide links to each individual record. A shared listing does not establish identical dimensions, materials or fitted modules.
